2LR INVESTMENTS LTD ron.

Director’s report

Principal activity

The company holds and manages investments funded by share capital, retained earnings and interest-free shareholder loans. This example assumes investment administration rather than an active trading business.

Results and distributions

Profit for the year after tax is £41,500 (2025: £31,500). No dividends were declared in the illustrated year. The profit is retained.

Funding and liquidity

Cash at 31 March 2026 was £150,000. Shareholder loan principal of £2,385,500 is presented within creditors falling due within one year in this example. The directors must assess the actual loan terms, availability of financial support and the going-concern basis before approval.

Director’s responsibilities

The directors are responsible for selecting appropriate accounting policies, maintaining adequate records, assessing the company’s ability to continue as a going concern and approving accounts that meet the applicable requirements.

Audit and accounting framework

Audit status and the accounting framework are not established by this mock-up. No audit opinion or exemption statement is asserted. A professional must determine eligibility and include the required wording and disclosures.

Notes to the financial statements

1. Basis of preparation

GBP illustrative historical reporting snapshot. Framework, measurement policies, impairment assessment, related-party requirements and going-concern evidence must be selected and documented by the appointed accountant. No FRS 105 eligibility is assumed.

2. Investments

Investments total £2,600,000. The reporting pack needs a reconciled schedule of quantities, costs, measurement bases, valuations and disposals, with any controlled-company interests distinguished from the underlying assets.

3. Tax

The illustrative current-year charge is £14,000, with a £500 prior-period adjustment. The tax creditor is £14,500. This is not a CT600 computation. Dividend exemptions, taxable interest and fund returns, gains, losses and expense claims need separate classification.

4. Shareholder funding

Alex Morgan · principal2,085,500
Other shareholder · principal300,000
Total shareholder loans2,385,500

Loans are interest-free in this example. Presentation assumes amounts are repayable on demand; actual signed terms and any financial-support undertakings require review. The later app snapshot shows £2,400,000 of shareholder principal at a different date.

5. Share capital

1,000 ordinary shares with an illustrative nominal value of £1 each. Rights, ownership and register entries must be verified.

6. Commitments, contingencies and subsequent events

Not assessed in this prototype. The directors and professional must complete the necessary enquiries and disclosures. A blank assessment is not a statement that none exist.
